class article
page 612x792 vmargin 124.802 hmargin 134.144 bmargin 119.253 parskip 0 plus 1pt parindent 15pt
para
  text "An invented line with a "
  box raise 3pt
    text "raised"
  text " word and a "
  box raise -1/1*(2pt)
    text "lowered"
  text " one."
para
  text "An invented "
  box raise 0 ground #FFFF00 pad 3pt
    text "grounded"
  text " word, a "
  box raise 0 ground #FFFF00 frame #FF0000 pad 3pt rule 0.4pt
    text "framed ground"
  text " and an "
  box raise 0 frame ink pad 3pt rule 0.4pt
    text "outlined"
  text " pair."
para
  text "An invented address "
  link "https://example.org/~probe"
    styled mono
      text "https://example.org/"
      role url-tilde
        box raise 200/1000ex
          styled size:scriptsize
            formula inline "\\sim"
              rel:∼
      text "probe"
  text " keeps its tilde low."
role par continues
columns
  column 120pt [c] in raise 0 frame ink pad 3pt rule 0.4pt
    para
      text "An invented framed block of words."
role par continues
columns
  column 1000/1000 [b] in raise \depth
    ragged left
      para
        text "An invented block standing"
        linebreak
        text "on its own depth."
